notes: Datasets shown in tab 03 (DESIGN/xrplh-29). Committed: names, descriptions, templates and folders relative to a data root, never data. root: 'samples' = sample-data (git-ignored), 'private' = the second allowedRoots entry in config/data-sources.json (real data, outside the repository). The same folder layout works under either root. engine crossask: a model writes one SQL query from column names only. engine domain-pack: the pack's reconciliation builds tables and its query bank (queries.json) answers exactly (sql) or through checked fact sheets (question). subfolders: list sub-folders holding data files as a Set picklist.

datasets.label: Small Biz Financials - 1
datasets.description: A small business's bank statement (Bank of America CSV export) with its open customer invoices and unpaid supplier bills (synthetic, from tools/smb-synth).

templates.label: Cash flow vs installment
templates.q: By month, how much cash came into and went out of our bank account (from the bank statement only, not the invoices or bills), and what was the net cash flow? Could it cover a loan installment of 20,368 a month?

templates.label: Receivables vs payables: need a loan?
templates.q: Based on our accounts receivable (unpaid customer invoices) and accounts payable (unpaid supplier bills), how much is owed to us and how much do we owe? Do we need a loan?

datasets.label: Practice Management - Dental
datasets.description: Curve Dental exports (day-sheet ledger, bank deposit detail, patient list) reconciled with the practice's Bank of America statement to find revenue leaks. SET-2 holds 10 generated scenarios (POS and 9 leak sets); sample-prms-fin holds anonymized sample exports.

setLabels.SET-2/NEG-EFT-MISSING: NEG-EFT-MISSING - an insurance EFT never arrived
setLabels.SET-2/NEG-REF-MISMATCH: NEG-REF-MISMATCH - ledger and deposit references differ
setLabels.SET-2/NEG-BANK-UNPOSTED: NEG-BANK-UNPOSTED - bank money Curve never posted
